text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — a Python and ML developer with 6 years of experience, including Streamlit, OpenAI API, LangChain, and pandas.

I’ve built a Streamlit app for Cobalt Coffee Roasters that grouped 38k reviews into themes and tracked sentiment each week, producing 12 stable themes and replacing about 2 days a month of manual tagging. I also built a contract clause search assistant over 9,000 contracts that always quoted the clause and page it used, reaching 0.91 faithfulness on a lawyer-written test set.

Your Streamlit caching / update issue sounds like a small, focused fix I can help with quickly. I’m familiar with Python app behavior, OpenAI responses, and debugging data flow in Streamlit, so I can trace the caching problem and get your app updating correctly.
